post.text:
The train to Auschwitz, 1942.
This footage, in color, shattered my heart.

So innocent. So noble.
At the final station, their lives vanished - dressed in their modest finery, moving toward the gas chambers.

Never again. Never again. https://t.co/7qBrktiPHI
post.author_description: Documenting the October 7 massacre |Journalist | Hell is not enough | Former Editor at 0404 News | Support my work:  https://t.co/SOtb4tJlxB

description.description: A series of frames from historical footage showing people at a transit camp, identified by the text as Kamp Westerbork. The people are seen wearing yellow stars on their clothing, signifying they are Jewish. They are carrying bags and bundles of belongings while moving towards or boarding large, brown wooden railway freight cars. Several individuals are wearing armbands, indicating they may be camp police or officials overseeing the deportation process.
